meta.title: fix: performance improvements for deploy history screen
meta.body_summary: Add composite DB indexes, optimize trigger function, fix URL validation, and implement a new HistoryTable Vue component with selective Supabase queries to improve deploy history screen performance.

perf_labels.notes: Devin submitted a multi-file DB + frontend perf PR; maintainer closed it immediately with 'merge block too old code base' without any technical review.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 751 changed lines across 8 files, this is a medium-sized edit by absolute volume, spanning database migrations, a new Vue component, and test files. As a mixed backend/frontend performance PR, it was closed without review due to an outdated base branch rather than on technical merit.

core_change_summary.description: Added composite indexes on deploy_history table, optimized trigger to update only current records, added URL validation fix, created a HistoryTable Vue component with optimized Supabase query selecting specific fields, and added tests.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Test files and localization added to support the changes.

Second commit: linting fixes in HistoryTable component.
Third commit: ensured deploy_history table creation migration includes indexes.
